card.name: Reading or declaring items on labels
card.fires_on: Small words and verbs just before the word "label" or similar, such as "check the", "read", "on package" and "declare", in advice to look at product labels or ingredient lists.

modes.label: The prompt to check the label
modes.description: Words like the, on or read in instructions to look at a product label.
modes.example: so check<< the>> label on these products carefully.

modes.label: The requirement to declare on a label
modes.description: Verbs or links about listing an ingredient on a label or ingredient statement.
modes.example: required to<< declare>> their presence by their respective names

card.writes: It pushes the next word toward label-type words such as label, labeling, markings and indicate (in English and Chinese).
card.plain: It responds to text that is about to say "label", as in reading or listing things on a product label.
